evidence_required: A red-then-green record for the new stale-local-default test: it must fail against the current preference order and pass after the inversion.
resolve_default_branch_ref, run against the coordinator repository while it sits on branch claude/guardian-approval-planning-13e494, returns a ref whose tip equals origin/main's tip.
failing_acceptance_criteria: A worktree created while the coordinator sits on a feature branch is cut from the default branch, proven by the new branch's tip equalling the default branch tip (git rev-parse) and 'git diff <default>...<new branch>' being empty at creation.
failing_checklist_items: resolve_default_branch_ref (scripts/shiki_runtime.py, 'for ref in (name, f"origin/{name}")') prefers the LOCAL default branch over the remote-tracking ref. In a Shiki coordinator repository the local default branch is never checked out and goes stale. Measured live in this repository while it sits on claude/guardian-approval-planning-13e494: local 'main' is 25 commits behind 'origin/main' and is missing PRs #181, #183, #184, #185, #186 and the 16-contract Contract PR #182. A worktree cut from it does not equal the default branch tip, which is what the criterion requires.

No test pins the stale-local-default case. tests/test_worktree_base.py:220 covers only 'local ref ABSENT -> fall back to origin/<name>'; it never constructs a local default branch that exists but lags its remote, so the defect is invisible to the suite and the suite is green with the bug present.

The resolver never fetches. scripts/shiki_loop.py:863 runs 'git fetch origin main' immediately before cutting its closeout worktree from origin/main; the dispatch path added here has no equivalent, so even the remote-tracking ref can be arbitrarily stale.
minimal_required_changes: In scripts/shiki_runtime.py resolve_default_branch_ref, invert the preference order to try 'origin/<name>' BEFORE local '<name>', keeping the same named ShikiError when neither resolves. Before resolving, refresh the remote-tracking ref with a best-effort 'git fetch origin <name>' (check=False, non-fatal). This matches scripts/shiki_loop.py:863-864, which already fetches and cuts from origin/main and is the behaviour ADR 0012's closeout path depends on. Update the docstring: the stated reason for preferring local ('consistency with the loop's git diff --cached main') does not hold, because that local ref is the stale one.

In tests/test_worktree_base.py add a case that pins the defect: a repo whose local default branch EXISTS but lags its remote-tracking ref. Assert resolve_default_branch_ref returns the remote-tracking ref, and that a worktree cut through ensure_physical_worktree lands on the remote tip, not the stale local tip. Keep the existing absent-local fallback case.
prohibited_changes: Do not widen the task's locks. Stay inside scripts/shiki_runtime.py, tests/test_worktree_base.py and scripts/test_shiki_runner_claude.sh.
Do not change scripts/shiki_loop.py, including its 'git rev-list --count main..HEAD' which reads the same stale local ref. That is a separate recorded finding, out of this contract's scope.
Do not make a failed fetch fatal. Dispatch must still work offline when the refs are already present.
Do not edit the frozen task contract, its acceptance_checks, locks or risk_level.
stop_condition: If inverting the preference breaks an existing test in a way that reveals a real dependency on the local ref, stop and report rather than weakening that test.
verification_commands: bash scripts/test_shiki_runner_claude.sh && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target .
